The view is split-level, showing the crocodile above the waterline and its reflection/submerged body below. The background includes artificial rockwork, a metal gate, and a door. There are also fish visible in the submerged section.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is clearly visible and matches the V-shaped snout characteristic of crocodiles, distinct from the U-shape of alligators.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is visible extending to the right, appearing muscular and consistent with crocodilian anatomy, though the full length comparison is hard to judge precisely due to perspective.
